jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, FinTech
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you interested in building high-performance, globally scalable Financial systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation leveraging the scalability and innovation with Amazon's AWS cloud services? Do you have a passion for ensuring a positive customer experience? This is the job for you.  
  
Amazon's Finance Technology organization (FinTech) is responsible for building and maintaining the critical finance technology applications that enable new business growth, ensure compliance with financial and tax reporting obligations, and provide deep analysis of Amazon's financial data. This function is of paramount importance to the company, as it underpins Amazon's ability to effectively manage its finances and drive continued expansion.  
  
Amazon Financial Technology Team is looking for a results-oriented, driven software development engineer, who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable financial systems. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real-time. We need someone to design and develop services that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually.  
  
This is a unique opportunity to be part of a mission-critical initiative with significant organizational visibility and impact.  
  
Design Foundational Greenfield Services: You will collaborate with your team to architect and implement the core services that will form the backbone of this new accounting software. Your technical expertise and innovative thinking will be instrumental in ensuring the foundational services are designed with scalability, reliability, and performance in mind for Amazon.  
  
Adopting Latest Technology: You will have the chance to work with the latest technologies, frameworks, and tools to build these foundational services. This includes leveraging advancements in areas such as cloud computing, distributed systems, data processing, and real-time analytics.  
  
Solving High-Scale Processing Challenges: This project will involve handling millions of transactions per day, presenting you with the unique challenge of designing and implementing robust, high-performance solutions that can handle this scale of volume efficiently. You will be challenged to tackle complex problems related to data processing, queuing, and real-time analytics.  
  
Cross-Functional and Senior Engineer Collaboration: You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, and accountants. You will also be working directly with multiple Principal Engineers and presenting your work to Senior Principal Engineers. This experience will give you the opportunities and visibility to help build the required leadership skills to enhance your career.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define high level and low level design for software solutions using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment.
* Take the lead on defining and implementing engineering best practices and using data to define and improve operational best practices.
* Help drive the architecture and technology choices for FinTech accounting products.
* Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazon accounting needs.
* Raise the bar on code quality, including security, readability, consistency, maintainability

  
About the team  
At the heart of FinTech's mission is the Financial Close Systems team, which builds and operates the technologies to support accurate internal and external financial reporting . The Close systems team provides capabilities to teams across FGBS orgs including Accounting, Finance, and Tax to effectively report the consolidated financials to external authorities. The work of the Close systems team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical month end close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Dynamics 365 and Power Platform depend on a core data platform that manages business data, transactions, security, extensibility and application lifecycle at enterprise scale. As customers modernize applications and adopt AI, the platform keeps data governed, available and economically sustainable, with the controls enterprise business systems require.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the administrator experience and self-service workflows on the shared Dataverse + Finance & Operations platform team. You will independently set the strategy and roadmap for experiences that make environments easier to understand, manage and trust, translating platform governance policies into clear administrator controls and actionable workflows. Through customer discovery, evidence-led prioritization and close engineering partnership, you will deliver measurable improvements in service awareness, administrator control and self-service, strengthening the application foundation that connected experiences depend on.

This Hyderabad-based role offers meaningful product ownership at an important point in the evolution of enterprise applications: improving the administration and governance experiences that help customers operate mission-critical applications (such as their ERP) and provide dependable foundations for business applications, analytics, and AI. You will work closely with engineering, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform teams, administrators, customers, and partner teams to turn operational needs into clear product priorities and measurable customer outcomes. The role is well suited to a product leader who enjoys understanding complex customer problems, shaping a focused roadmap, and making enterprise platforms easier to manage and trust.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own product strategy, roadmap and outcomes for the F&O administrator experience and self-service workflows, grounded in user research, service signals and support insight.
* Define the experience for understanding service health, data and environment status, and the actions available to keep business operations dependable.
* Translate platform governance policies into administrator controls and lifecycle workflows that help customers understand usage, apply policies and manage their data with appropriate visibility and control.
* Set product requirements for availability, performance, observability, compatibility, administrator control and successful task completion.
* Use customer discovery, support insight and product evidence to identify administrator needs and prioritize reusable platform improvements with engineering.
* Make management and environment governance clearer and more proactive, helping administrators resolve needs and manage their environments with confidence and self-service.
* Partner with Dataverse, application and agent teams so reliable F&O operations and supported business data or actions can contribute to connected experiences as capabilities evolve.
* Define and review measures such as task success, service understanding, policy completion, successful self-service, customer effort and avoidable support demand; use results to refine the roadmap.

 **Qualifications**  

**Minimum qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience in product, service or program management or software development, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred qualifications**
============================

* 2+ years of experience taking a product, feature, or customer experience from discovery and design through launch, including an internal tool or framework.
* 4+ years of experience improving an in-market product or experience using customer and product measures such as adoption, task success, usage, retention, or reduced support effort.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS, ERP, cloud platforms, or administrator-facing products.
* Familiarity with service telemetry, diagnostics, capacity or performance, and environment lifecycle concepts.
* Experience simplifying technically complex workflows for administrators or support teams.
* Experience with AI-assisted workflows or responsible automation, and the communication and influence to align engineering and partner teams.

Product leaders from outside Dynamics 365 bring valuable perspectives. We value curiosity, attentive customer listening and the ability to make complex systems easier to operate.

jobs.title: Senior Content Specialist
jobs.description:
**Description**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The position is a non-supervisory position in our Digital Marketing team. This position is responsible for creating and/or customizing content for marketing assets like emails, advertisements, social media posts, infographics, flyers, brochures, presentations, etc. This position will work closely with other members of the digital marketing team, business units, internal graphic designers and communication team, regional colleagues, freelance graphic designers and agencies.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Content Specialist has the following responsibilities:

* **Content Development & Optimization** - Develop, write, and refine high-quality content for digital marketing assets including emails, landing/webpages, campaign materials, and ecommerce/product content. Ensure all content is aligned with campaign messaging, audience needs, and brand voice. Optimize content for discoverability and engagement across digital channels using best practices in content structuring and search optimization.
* **Ecommerce Content & Product Experience -** Develop and maintain ecommerce and product-focused content that supports product discovery, understanding, and conversion.Create clear, structured, and informative product descriptions, value propositions, and supporting content aligned with user intent and business objectives. Ensure consistency and accuracy across product content, and optimize content presentation for usability and digital experience.
* **Campaign Content Execution -** Execute content requirements for planned campaigns and ad-hoc initiatives based on defined briefs and timelines. Work closely with campaign managers and content strategy lead to translate requirements into clear, accurate, and effective content deliverables. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely delivery across all assigned tasks.
* **Content Reusability & Asset Management -** Develop content in a modular and reusable format to support scalability across campaigns and channels. Contribute to and leverage structured content repositories, ensuring proper organization, version control, and alignment with content standards. Identify opportunities to reuse and adapt existing content.
* **Organic Content & Channel Support –** Support the development and execution of content for organic channels such as LinkedIn, Facebook, and thought leadership initiatives. Adapt content formats and messaging for different platforms while maintaining consistency with overall campaign objectives.
* **Content Optimization & Continuous Improvement -** Review and refine content based on feedback, stakeholder inputs, and performance insights (where available). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve content effectiveness, clarity, and audience engagement over time.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

**Example:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in digital content creation or ecommerce content
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or scientific content domains
* Strong understanding of SEO/GEO/AEO fundamentals and content optimization for digital discovery
* Experience writing for multiple formats including campaign content, emails, landing pages, and ecommerce/product content
* Ability to interpret briefs and translate them into structured, high-quality content with minimal iteration…

**Job Description:**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Software Engineer I to join the JustPerform product team. JustPerform is an enterprise software product in the financial performance management space, supporting workflows in areas such as financial planning, analysis, and financial close. You will work across the full stack, building features on a Vue 3 frontend and a Spring Boot backend, for customers who operate in complex, high-stakes financial environments.

This is a role for someone who is past the learning curve of the basics and ready to take on meaningful feature work independently. You will be expected to contribute across both frontend and backend, write code that your teammates are happy to review, and bring a genuine curiosity about how modern tools, including AI, can make you a better engineer.

**What You'll Do**

* Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, building and maintaining REST APIs in a production environment.

* Working knowledge of relational databases: writing queries, understanding joins and indexes, and contributing to schema design.

* Familiarity with TypeScript in a frontend codebase; comfortable with types, interfaces, and generics at a working level.

* Experience writing tests across the stack: Vitest for Vue 3 component and unit testing on the frontend, JUnit for unit and integration testing on the backend.

* Experience with Pinia for state management in Vue 3 applications.

* Familiarity with Git workflows in a team environment: branching, pull requests, code review, and resolving conflicts.

**About us**

Two Circles is a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best. We help clients understand and influence how fans spend, which events they attend, which channels they respond to and what content they watch.

Our platforms and services are trusted by 1,000+ clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL and the Board of Control for Cricket India (BCCI).[RB1] We’re 1,000+ people across 15 offices.

**The role**

Join our global squad of software and data engineers building the Audience Intelligence Platform, the leading data management and analytics platform for the sports industry. You’ll build the React frontend and .NET services that let teams, leagues and rights holders explore fan data, build audiences and act on insight, increasingly through AI-powered experiences.

You’ll work in an AI-augmented way: using tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to ship faster, and building AI features directly into the product.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, build and test scalable React/TypeScript applications and .NET APIs (C#, ASP.NET Web API/MVC).
* Build AI-powered UI features such as natural-language audience building, conversational analytics, AI-generated insights and summaries, and smart recommendations.
* Design interfaces for AI interactions: streaming responses, loading and error states, citations and confidence cues, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Build APIs that expose fan behaviour analytics to the UI and to AI services.
* Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, and help the team shape good practice: prompting, code review of AI-generated code, testing and guardrails.
* Work closely with product and marketing to turn data into high-value features.

**Requirements**  

* Strong React and TypeScript experience, including component architecture, state management, and performance.
* Strong HTML5 (semantic, accessible) and CSS3/SCSS (responsive, themeable).
* Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot or similar) in day-to-day development, with a clear view of their strengths and limits.
* CI/CD experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), prompt design, tool/function calling, or MCP.

* Experience implementing AI features in a UI: LLM-backed chat or copilots, generative UI, or AI-assisted search and filtering.

Skills can be learned. Attitude and the ability to learn quickly matter most in this team, especially as AI changes how we build software.

**Overview**
**ABOUT JAGGAER**
JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
  
  
Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
  
  
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
  
  
JAGGAER is an AI-powered procure to pay and source to pay software solutions platform for manufacturing, public sector and higher education.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Product Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director of Product Management, JAI
  
  
**Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
This role owns JAGGAER's analytics and data products: the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the next generation of data products we build for customers. These are established, revenue-generating capabilities with live commitments across the customer base, and they are being reshaped by AI faster than any other part of the platform.
  
  
The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.

* Market and customer insight: Validate problems and proposed capabilities directly with customers and prospects, and use that evidence to prioritise. Support analytics and data content in RFPs and executive briefings.
* Agile execution: Translate product requirements into clear, well-defined requirements and acceptance criteria for the engineering teams, and work with them through delivery.

Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform**
who is passionate about running managed compute services at scale, namely App Platform, Serverless Functions, and Container Registry, and who understands that a great platform experience is built on well-run infrastructure underneath it.
  
  
As a Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform at DigitalOcean, you will join a dynamic team dedicated to revolutionizing cloud computing. You will own the product strategy and roadmap for App Platform, Serverless Functions, and Container Registry (DOCR), the managed compute services that turn DO's Droplet fleet into a place where developers can ship without thinking about servers. That means owning both sides of each service, the developer-facing product and the platform economics beneath it, such as how workloads are packed onto compute, what each app, function, or image pull costs to serve, and how processor, virtualization, and container runtime trends shape our roadmap. You will report to the Director of Product and partner day to day with the Hyderabad-based Compute Cloud Services engineering team that builds the business logic, APIs, and control plane for DO Compute, as well as with our Droplet/VPC, Kubernetes, and infrastructure product peers, finance, and GTM. The ideal person becomes the PM who can hold a customer conversation about deploy workflows in the morning and a capacity and margin conversation in the afternoon, the partner engineering trusts on architecture tradeoffs, and a core part of building out the compute platform PM group in India.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for App Platform, Serverless Functions, and DOCR, aligned with DO's overall compute platform strategy, and translate them into prioritized, well-scoped features that are simple to use and efficient to run.
* Own the platform economics of these services. Define how apps, functions, and registry storage map onto Droplets and shared compute, track cost to serve per unit of customer workload, and drive utilization, density, and bin-packing improvements with engineering and finance.
* Stay ahead of the compute landscape that underpins the platform, including processor roadmaps from Intel, AMD, and ARM, virtualization and microVM technologies, and container runtimes and isolation models, and translate those trends into platform decisions such as instance sizing, runtime choices, and price/performance tiers.
* Define the end-to-end developer journey across these services, from source repo or container image to a deployed, autoscaled, observable app or function, and remove the seams (auth, networking, registry, logs, billing) that make customers stitch it together themselves today.
* Work backwards from customers. Run discovery with developers, startups, and SMB platform teams, mine support and community signal, and turn it into clear jobs-to-be-done, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Own packaging and pricing for platform services, including how compute, egress, build minutes, storage, invocations, and image pulls are metered, how pricing tracks cost to serve, and how the services attach to Droplets, GPUs, managed databases, DOKS, and Spaces.
* Partner with engineering on architecture tradeoffs in the control plane and data plane, such as build pipelines, autoscaling and scheduling behavior, cold start and concurrency for Serverless Functions, registry performance and garbage collection, and multi-region placement.
* Drive performance, reliability, and efficiency outcomes with clear SLOs and cost targets, and champion the fixes that move them.
* Monitor the competitive landscape for managed compute and PaaS offerings, and identify where DO can differentiate on simplicity, price/performance, or both.
* Lead launches end to end with product marketing, docs, sales, and support, and own the results after GA, including adoption, activation, retention, and margin.

Key metrics
  
  

* Platform services revenue and attach rate (share of Droplet, GPU, database, and DOKS customers also running App Platform or Serverless Functions, and share pulling from DOCR).
* Infrastructure efficiency, measured as fleet utilization and density for the compute serving these services, and cost per unit of customer workload (per app instance, per invocation, per GB stored and pulled).
* Gross margin per service, and the gap between pricing and cost to serve as the fleet and processor mix evolve.
* Activation, retention, and expansion, measured as time to first deploy and as apps, functions, and registries active at 30/90/180 days.
* Reliability and performance against SLO, e.g. deploy and build success rate, control plane availability, Serverless Functions cold start p95, image pull latency.

What you'll add to DigitalOcean
  
  

* 8+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record defining and launching managed cloud compute, PaaS, serverless, or container products, ideally where you owned both the customer experience and the unit economics.
* Strong working knowledge of PaaS, serverless, and container registry models, including buildpack-based deploys, function runtimes and triggers, concurrency and cold start tradeoffs, and OCI image build, storage, and distribution.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
Arcesium is looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own and drive the evolution of our Tax Product for the Alternative Investment industry. This is a builder’s role for someone who can work closely with Engineering to translate complex tax workflows into scalable technology solutions—from requirements definition through production delivery.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has personally built and shipped technology solutions for hedge fund tax operations. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience taking products or platform capabilities from concept and requirements through design, development, testing, and production, working closely with engineering teams throughout the process.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of tax domain expertise, product thinking, and technology execution. You should be comfortable understanding complex hedge fund tax workflows, identifying opportunities to solve them through technology, defining clear product requirements, and partnering hands-on with Engineering to deliver solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user focused.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the product: Drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery for the Tax Product roadmap, working directly with engineering through the full lifecycle from problem definition to production.
* Go deep on the technical detail: Translate hedge fund tax mechanics like partnership allocations, wash sales, tax lot classification, K-1 processing, and regulatory filings (FBAR, FATCA, FIN48) into precise specifications.
* Engage clients directly: Handle client and internal stakeholder questions on tax product with the accuracy and timeliness the role demands.
* Support the roadmap: Contribute to and eventually own the vision and roadmap for the Tax Product that is informed by market trends and the needs of Alternative Investment clients.
* Grow with the role: This role starts as an individual contributor. Candidates who demonstrate strong independent delivery and domain command will have a path to leading the Tax Product team, earned through performance.

**What You'll Need**

* 8–12 years of experience in US Taxation, with hands-on domain expertise in US Tax Compliance and Planning for Hedge Funds.
* Working knowledge of wash sales, tax lot classification (including Section 1256 treatment), K-1 and investor allocation processing, and regulatory filings such as FBAR, FATCA, and FIN48.
* Direct, verifiable experience building or delivering technology solutions for tax operations like platform features, workflow automation, or systems you helped design and ship with an engineering team.
* Ability to work independently and produce accurate output that holds up on subsequent reviews.
* Strong communication skills, with a track record of meeting client and internal commitments on time.
* An outstanding academic background and genuine interest in working in a high-tech software development environment.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Center of Excellence)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a senior OT cybersecurity engineer to join the Grid Automation Cybersecurity Centre of Excellence (COE), a new central team that owns how cybersecurity is executed on GA projects worldwide.
  
  
The role is hands-on. You will design, build, configure, test and optionally commission security solutions on complex utility and industrial projects. You will then turn that work into the standards, templates and training that regional teams use on every project that follows.
  
  
You will be the recognized technical owner for a set of solutions in the GA cybersecurity portfolio, covering areas such as firewalls, OT network monitoring, secure remote access, identity, PKI, SIEM, etc... Regional teams will come to you when a project goes beyond their depth.
  
  
You will also make execution faster and more consistent. That means automating repeatable build and verification work in PowerShell, and using frontier AI models to shorten documentation, requirements mapping and configuration review, while engineering judgement and the protection of customer data stay firmly with you.

**Job Description**
===================

**About the Cybersecurity COE**

The COE gives GA a single owner for cybersecurity execution standards and process across all regions. It reports into the GA OT Cybersecurity Product Line and covers five functions:

* Delivery of complex project scope, and specialist support to regions on demand.
* A standard execution toolkit: security plans, reference architectures, checklists, templates and automation scripts that regions can apply directly.
* A structured competency programme of periodic technical and non-technical training.
* Formal cybersecurity reviews at key project milestones.
* Regulatory intelligence on IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA and regional mandates, so execution teams are ready for compliance before customers ask.
  

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Project execution**

* Lead the cybersecurity workstream on Tier 1 projects end to end: requirements review, security architecture, detailed design, build, configuration, FAT, SAT, commissioning and handover.
* Work hands-on in staging and at customer sites: build and harden Windows and Linux servers, and configure firewalls, Active Directory, PKI, KDC, network intrusion detection, SIEM and syslog, application control, backup and recovery, and secure remote access.
* Produce the project security deliverables: security plan, zone and conduit model, risk assessment, hardening records, test procedures and reports, and the security handover package.
* Map customer requirements to contract scope early, flag deviations as they arise, and give project managers the technical basis for change orders.
* Support tender and project teams with scope definition and effort estimates for complex cybersecurity scope.
  

  

**Execution standards and toolkit**

* Act as the technical owner (Expert) for an assigned set of COE competencies. Set the reference configuration for each and keep it current with product and partner releases.
* Build the GA execution toolkit as a by-product of delivery: reference architectures, configuration baselines, build checklists, PowerShell scripts, how-to guides, test procedures and templates.
* Run formal design and configuration reviews at project milestones, so misconfigurations are found before FAT and handover rather than by the customer.
* Capture lessons learned at project close and feed them back into the toolkit.
  

  

**Automation and AI-assisted execution**

* Write and maintain PowerShell scripts and modules that automate repeatable execution tasks: Windows Server and workstation hardening, Active Directory and Group Policy build, account and group provisioning, certificate enrolment, audit policy and log forwarding setup, and backup job configuration.
* Build automated checks that compare as-built systems against the COE reference baselines and produce the evidence for milestone reviews, FAT and SAT, so verification no longer depends on manual screenshots and spot checks.
* Use frontier AI models to speed up execution work: drafting and reviewing security plans, test procedures and as-built documents; mapping customer specifications against IEC 62443-3-3 requirements; analysing firewall rule bases, configuration exports and logs; and writing and reviewing scripts.
* Use AI only within GE Vernova approved platforms and data-handling rules. Customer configurations, network drawings and logs from critical infrastructure stay inside approved boundaries, and an engineer verifies every AI output before it reaches a customer or a live system.
* Turn proven scripts, prompts and AI-assisted workflows into toolkit assets, so regional engineers get the same gains on Tier 2 and Tier 3 projects.
  

  

**Competency building**

* Design and deliver structured technical training for regional engineers, from foundation to advanced level, on the solutions you own.
* Coach regional engineers on live projects, so that project types can move from Tier 1 to Tier 2, and from Tier 2 to Tier 3.
* Maintain independent working capability (Backup) in competencies owned by COE colleagues, so the team keeps delivering when one person is unavailable.
  

  

**Specialist support and regulatory intelligence**

* Provide on-demand support to regional teams on design questions, site troubleshooting and escalations.
* Support patch management, vulnerability assessment and incident response engagements on GA-delivered systems, working with Product Security.
* Track IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62351 and regional mandates, and translate new requirements into execution checklists and deliverables.
* Help regional teams answer customer compliance questions that arise during project execution.
  

  

**Product and partner feedback**

* Feed field experience back to Product Management and R&D: integration issues, recurring defects and gaps in the portfolio.
* Support validation and first deploy…

Specialist, Technology Risk Management

An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. Role Overview
  
  
The position acts as a trusted risk advisor, translating technical risk into business context and supporting the implementation of practical, risk-based controls that enable safe business operations and innovation.
  
  
The Business Information Risk Specialist supports the alignment of cybersecurity, information risk management, and compliance activities of the Information Technology Risk Management Security (ITRMS) organization with the objectives of our company’s Research Laboratories Business Unit. The role partners with one of the IT, business stakeholders supporting research, development, clinical operations, regulatory, and ITRMS to identify, assess, document, and help mitigate information security and compliance risks across applications, data, cloud services, third parties, and digital initiatives.
  
  
What will you do in this role

Job Title

**Business Analyst – Alpha Index HUB**

  

**Organization**

Alpha Product Organization – Alpha Index HUB (AIH)

  

**Role Summary**

The Business Analyst (BA) for the Alpha Index HUB (AIH) is a key contributor within the Product Organization, responsible for translating business, operational, and client needs into clear, actionable product requirements. The role supports the design, build, testing, and rollout of scalable index and benchmark data capabilities that are critical to Alpha’s data platform.

This position works closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA), Operations, and third‑party data vendors to ensure product enhancements are well‑defined, operable, auditable, and aligned with Alpha product strategy and delivery standards.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product & Requirements Management**

* Partner with Product Owners to define, document, and refine product requirements aligned with Alpha Index HUB strategy and roadmap.
* Lead requirements elicitation through stakeholder interviews, workflow analysis, and data analysis.
* Produce high‑quality artifacts including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional and non‑functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, and traceable through development and testing phases.
  

  

**Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration**

* Act as the primary liaison between Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and external vendors.
* Facilitate discussions to ensure shared understanding of scope, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Work closely with Operations teams to incorporate operational workflows, controls, and exception handling into product requirements.
  

  

**Delivery & Execution Support**

* Support Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews.
* Define detailed acceptance criteria, covering positive, negative, and edge‑case scenarios, to enable effective QA and UAT/CUAT execution.
* Participate in testing activities and support validation of delivered functionality against business intent.
  

  

**Operational Readiness & Risk Management**

* Ensure product requirements address data quality, auditability, operational transparency, and control considerations.
* Contribute to the definition of dashboards, status indicators, and monitoring frameworks that support daily operational validation and issue detection.
* Assist with documentation and communication of field definitions, status meanings, and operational behaviors to reduce ambiguity and risk.
  

  

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, enhance usability, and improve operational efficiency.
* Support ongoing evolution and maturity of Alpha Index HUB capabilities in alignment with broader Alpha product and platform initiatives.
  

**Required Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* **15+ years of experience** as a Business Analyst, with level determined by role (BA, BA II, Senior BA).

* Proven experience producing BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  

  

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to translate complex technical and data concepts into clear business requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Hands‑on experience writing and reviewing SQL queries to support data analysis, validation, and issue investigation.
* Working knowledge of running, monitoring, and validating processes in the Charles River Development (CRD) environment, including awareness of upstream/downstream dependencies, batch processing, and operational workflows.
  

  

**Preferred Domain Knowledge**

* Experience with financial services, index, benchmark, or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with large‑scale data pipelines, dashboards, or operational monitoring tools.
* Understanding of data governance, controls, and audit considerations.
  

**Reporting & Alignment**

* Reports into the Alpha Product Organization.
* Works in close partnership with Alpha Index HUB Product Owners, Engineering leads, QA teams, and Operations stakeholders.
* Embedded within product delivery cadence, including sprint planning, refinement, and release activities.
  

**Measures of Success**

* Requirements are clearly defined, consistently understood, and require minimal rework.
* Engineering and QA teams can deliver features efficiently with reduced clarification cycles.
* Operations teams gain improved visibility, consistency, and confidence in Alpha Index HUB processing.
* Product enhancements materially improve platform reliability, transparency, and scalability.

**Core Skills**

* Hands-on with design patterns, system architecture documentation, and review.

* Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams and driving Agile ceremonies like sprint planning and retrospectives.
* Bonus: Exposure to financial domain projects, messaging systems (RabbitMQ, IBM MQ), and system observability tools.

**Why Join Us**  
At Ness, you will work with diverse, talented professionals who are dedicated to making an impact through technology. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement, we’d love to connect with you if this role excites you. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates each team member’s unique talents.

With flexible remote options, diverse projects, and access to development resources, joining Ness means building a career that’s meaningful and impactful.

**What to Expect Next**

We believe great experiences start with transparency—and that includes our hiring process. Here’s what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply":

1. HR Interview – A conversation to get to know you better and align on expectations.

2. Technical Interview – A chance to showcase your skills and experience.

3. Client Interview – Ensuring mutual fit between you and the client team.

4. Offer Stage – If everything aligns, we’ll be happy to make it official.

While many of our roles involve just 2–3 steps, some client processes may include additional conversations. Regardless of the path, we aim to keep every step transparent and respectful of your time.

**Ready to Start Your Journey?**

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial AI Product Owner
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
Analytics Delivery, Tools & AI Products
  
  

* Product co-ownership: Serve as dedicated product co-owner for the Agentic MMx (Marketing Mix) and Always on Insights (AOI) Platform – partner on its strategy, vision, roadmap, and stakeholder alignment in collaboration with BI&T and Data Science. Drive the ongoing evolution of this self-service analytics hub to deliver advanced capabilities, including MMx, scenario simulation, investment planning, constrained optimization, and real-time decision support.
* Workflow integration: Partner with BI&T to integrate decision-science outputs into annual planning, CRM (e.g., Veeva), and omnichannel orchestration workflows via APIs and embedded dashboards to ensure sustained adoption and business impact.
* Monitoring & oversight: Support monitoring and governance dashboards for real-time oversight of model/data health, user adoption, SLAs, drift/stability, and auditability.
* Collaboration: Partner with BI&T, Data Science, TA Analytics, and engineering to deliver analytics-ready datasets, feature stores, semantic layers, and automated data pipelines, standardizing and accelerating insight generation.
* Efficiency and Innovation: Champion automation, templated workflows, and platform creation to reduce manual effort and external vendor reliance, maximizing reuse and operational efficiency. Continuously identify opportunities for tool innovation and scalable enablement of best practice measurement solutions.
* Product KPIs & enablement: Define and track product KPIs—adoption, activation, retention, and model accuracy vs. business lift—and build training content, enablement, and adoption playbooks to drive sustained usage and value realization.

Agentic & AI Capability Development
  
  

* Support the design and deployment of autonomous and semi-autonomous analytics agents using multi-agent frameworks, enabling progression from descriptive analytics to causal analysis, root-cause insights, and predictive recommendations.
* Contribute to the AI product lifecycle—proof-of-concept, pilot, rollout, and continuous optimization—while helping establish governance covering safety, security, ethical standards, and privacy compliance.
* Operationalize LLMs for commercial use cases such as knowledge retrieval, summarization, generative analytics, and automation of insight generation.

Stakeholder Partnership & Strategic Support
  
  

* Partner closely with US Commercial stakeholders, Global Analytics, OCx, Marketing, UX/Design, and BI&T to understand business needs, scope analytical solutions, and design impactful deliverables.
* Act as a strategic thought partner—helping stakeholders frame decisions, interpret insights, and understand trade-offs and implications.
* Articulate ROI and business cases to guide AI investment, prioritization, and resource-allocation decisions—quantifying expected business lift against cost, effort, and risk.
* Collaborate closely with UX/Design to shape intuitive, user-centered product experiences that maximize adoption, ease of use, and stakeholder trust.
* Manage and prioritize competing business demands across time zones to ensure alignment with strategic objectives and effective demand management for the Hyderabad hub.

Technical Oversight, Governance, Compliance & Trust
  
  

* Oversee all technical tasks performed by the analytics team, including dashboards, business rules, documentation, automated pipelines, and model governance.
* Coordinate with BI&T teams to ensure reliable, timely, and scalable data flows into downstream analytics and reporting solutions.
* Partner with Data Governance, Legal, and Privacy teams to apply data/AI governance: SLAs, RACI, privacy-by-design, and responsible/ethical AI controls.
* Ensure analytical outputs are well-documented, reproducible, explainable, auditable, and compliant—monitoring for bias and incorporating human-in-the-loop mechanisms where required.

**Required Qualifications**
Education & Experience
  
  

* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) preferred in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Econometrics, or a related quantitative field; a BA/BS with strong relevant experience will be considered.
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in pharma commercial analytics or decision science, including experience developing and shipping production-grade AI led analytical solutions.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and developing analytics talent, and leading cross-functional pods in a global enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience building and scaling agentic AI solutions (multi-agent systems, LLMs, RAG, semantic layers, real-time architectures).
* Experience embedding AI analytics platforms into commercial workflows with enterprise-wide adoption.
* Extensive knowledge of pharmaceutical data (claims, APLD, specialty pharmacy, digital signals, promotional data).
* Product management/product owner (PM/PO) certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, Pragmatic Institute) a plus.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Outstanding stakeholder engagement and communication skills—capable of translating complex analytics concepts into actionable business strategies.
* Strong project management and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead diverse teams and manage multiple competing priorities.
* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize insights from disparate data sources.
* Strategic mind…

jobs.title: AI Business Analyst – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**About The Role**
At Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we enable high-value AI solutions (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic systems) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services, and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
  
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (typically ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (Agentic SDLC).
  
  
To support our rapid-turnaround, high-velocity engineering teams, we are seeking a highly skilled, deeply experienced IT Business Analyst. Operating in a highly regulated pharmaceutical and clinical environment (GxP), you will serve as the strategic interface between complex business priorities, regulatory compliance frameworks, and cutting-edge engineering realities. You are not a traditional analyst who merely documents requests; you are a passionate, technically literate individual contributor equipped with advanced AI skills (including prompt engineering & modern agentic workflows) and the business acumen to collaborate closely with product leaders. Furthermore, you possess strong Product Owner (PO) skills and are fully prepared to confidently act as a Proxy PO for the squad if necessary—managing the product backlog, defining sprint goals, and steering delivery timelines to align with Roche’s strategic objectives.
  
  
****Core Tech Stack & Scope****
This role requires a deep understanding of three core domains: AI systems, the life sciences and pharmaceutical business context, and the complexities of operating within a highly regulated environment.
  
  
The IT Business Analyst serves as the strategic bridge between complex business requirements and cutting-edge technical execution. You will take ownership of the end-to-end requirements lifecycle for AI initiatives, ensuring that all architectural designs and engineering deliverables are scalable, high-performing, and strictly compliant with global regulatory standards. By aligning technical roadmaps with strategic priorities, you will drive the delivery of robust AI solutions that provide measurable business value and maintain the highest levels of data integrity and quality assurance.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Agile Requirements & Product Owner Support (60% Focus):**

* Manage the full AI project lifecycle from opportunity identification through deployment and value realization
* Translate business goals into prioritized product backlogs, Epics, and User Stories with clear acceptance criteria
* Define MVP/MMR strategies to iteratively deliver business value while managing project risks
* Act as a Proxy PO when necessary, making critical decisions on prioritization and sprint goals

**LLM Prompt Engineering & Solution Prototyping:**

* Design and optimize LLM prompts to ensure accurate, secure, and relevant model outputs
* Prototype agentic workflows and evaluate model responses using Python scripting and SQL data exploration
* Develop specifications for dynamic Generative UI components and RAG pipeline context mappings

**Requirements Engineering & Business Process Analysis:**

* Lead requirements workshops and JAD sessions to elicit business and functional specifications
* Author standard-compliant artifacts including URS, FRS, and "as-is/to-be" process maps
* Conduct gap analyses and re-engineering assessments to optimize and automate manual workflows

**GxP Compliance, Computerized System Validation (CSV) & Software Assurance (CSA):**

* Guide compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments following GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Annex 11
* Guide risk-based CSA/CSV activities, authoring risk assessments (FMEA), trace matrices, and validation reports
* Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) and system classifications to preserve validated states

**AI Governance, Risk Management & Observability Specifications:**

* Ensure governance guardrails, escalation triggers, and observability requirements for agentic AI systems are applied
* Assess AI-specific risks (drift, leakage, tool misuse) and formulate TCO/ROI business cases

**Change Control, ITSM & Configuration Management:**

* Manage formal Change Requests (RFC) and present impact analyses to CAB/ECAB boards
* Maintain system configuration documentation and audit-readiness for internal and regulatory inspections

**Audit Readiness & Operational Support:**

* Act as IT SME during audits, presenting validation evidence and requirements engineering practices
* Author SOPs, manuals, and training materials to support business readiness and operational transitions

**Practical Skills Required**
****Experience**
:**

* 8+ years of IT Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise-scale software solutions, system integrations, and business processes
* 5+ years of experience in highly regulated environments, with a strong preference for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, or clinical healthcare sectors
* 3+ years of proven experience in Agile/Scrum product delivery, with demonstrated success managing product backlogs, writing detailed User Stories, and supporting agile ceremonies
* Hands-on AI/LLM Project Experience: Experience working directly on Generative AI or machine learning projects,…

jobs.title: Plumbing Project Manager
jobs.description:
Virat MEP Services is looking for an experienced **Plumbing Project Manager** for high-rise residential and commercial projects.

The candidate will be responsible for project planning, subcontractor hiring, material procurement, site supervision, quality control, billing, testing, commissioning and handover.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**Project planning and execution**

* Review approved drawings, specifications, BOQs, project schedules and site conditions before starting work.
* Prepare project schedules, work plans and activity-wise targets.
* Monitor daily and weekly progress, identify delays and take corrective action to meet project deadlines.
* Provide regular project updates to management and attend review meetings.

**Plumbing systems**

* Supervise the installation, testing and commissioning of:

+ Domestic water supply and distribution systems
+ Soil, waste, vent and sanitary drainage systems
+ Rainwater and stormwater drainage systems
+ Hot water and flushing water systems
+ Sumps, overhead tanks, pumps and associated piping
+ External water supply and drainage networks
+ Plumbing connections to sewage treatment plants (STPs)
+ Sanitary fixtures, fittings and related equipment

* Ensure work is carried out according to approved drawings, project specifications and applicable standards.
* Identify site clashes and technical issues and obtain the necessary clarifications and approvals.

**Subcontractor and site management**

* Identify, evaluate and hire suitable plumbing subcontractors based on project requirements.
* Allocate work to site teams and subcontractors based on project priorities.
* Monitor subcontractor productivity, workmanship and progress against targets.
* Guide site engineers, supervisors, plumbers and technicians on installation methods and resolve day-to-day technical problems.
* Work with civil, electrical, HVAC and other contractors to ensure smooth site execution.

**Material planning and procurement**

* Prepare material requirements based on approved drawings, BOQs and project schedules.
* Obtain quotations, arrange material approvals and purchase materials for timely delivery.
* Monitor material receipt, storage, issue and usage at site.
* Maintain material records and reconcile quantities to minimise shortages, delays and wastage.

**Quality, safety and documentation**

* Inspect plumbing installations and ensure workmanship meets project requirements.
* Arrange inspections with clients and consultants, and close punch points, defects and NCR observations.
* Supervise pressure testing, leakage testing, flushing and other required tests.
* Ensure site teams follow project health and safety requirements, including toolbox talks and safe working practices.
* Maintain daily and weekly progress reports, inspection requests, test records and other project documents.
* Support quantity verification, subcontractor bills, running account (RA) bills and variation records.
* Manage final testing, client inspections, handover documents and project close-out.

**Education and Experience**

* **Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or a related engineering discipline.**
* **ITI in Plumbing or a related trade** may also be considered for candidates with strong, relevant project management experience.
* Practical experience in plumbing execution for high-rise residential or commercial projects.
* Experience managing site teams, subcontractors, materials and project schedules.
* Ability to read plumbing drawings, review BOQs and work with clients and consultants.
* Knowledge of plumbing testing, commissioning and applicable project standards.

**Desired Skills**

* Plumbing project planning and site execution
* High-rise construction experience
* Subcontractor hiring and management
* Material planning and procurement
* Drawing and BOQ review
* Client and consultant communication
* Quality control and site safety
* Quantity tracking and RA billing
* Testing, commissioning and handover
* MS Excel, email and progress reporting
* Leadership and problem-solving

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst FP&A, VIACHAIN
jobs.description:
**Join Us as FP&A Manager, VIACHAIN!**

Are you a hands-on finance professional who thrives on turning complex data into actionable business insights? We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented FP&A Manager to play a key role in driving financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business decision support across a global organization for VIACHAIN, an ORBCOMM company.

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance leader with a strong accounting and analytical foundation, ideally gained through a Big 4 accounting firm and global business exposure.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

As an FP&A Manager, you will be a critical partner to finance and business leaders, supporting strategic planning, forecasting, reporting, and commercial decision-making.

Based in Hyderabad in a hybrid work environment, you will collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders located in the United States and Canada, gaining exposure to global operations and cross-functional business initiatives.

This role offers a highly visible opportunity to influence business performance through rigorous analysis, financial modeling, and insightful recommendations.

**What You'll Do**

**Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting**

* Support the annual budgeting process, including development of assumptions, detailed financial models, and budget consolidations.
* Support periodic and rolling forecast processes by updating models, analyzing trends, and validating assumptions.
* Maintain and enhance revenue, backlog, and headcount forecasting models.
* Develop and track business unit capital expenditure (CapEx) and operating expenditure (OpEx) performance.

**Financial Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Support monthly financial reporting processes, including Flash reporting and Growth Day materials.

* Maintain key financial and operational metrics used for performance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.
* Perform variance analysis, including actual versus budget and forecast bridge analyses with clear driver-based commentary.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support business performance and decision-making.

**Business Partnering & Commercial Finance Support**

* Prepare initial deal models and supporting CRB presentation materials.
* Partner with Sales teams to validate deal assumptions and assess financial impacts.
* Conduct account-level pricing, profitability, and revenue impact analyses.
* Support budget control activities, including purchase requisitions (PRs), purchase orders (POs), invoicing, and related processes.

**Data Management, Modeling & Operational Support**

* Perform ad hoc financial analyses, reporting, and scenario modeling as required.
* Support month-end close activities and planning/BI data integrity initiatives.
* Work with large datasets and reporting tools to ensure accuracy, consistency, and actionable insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, financial models, and analytical capabilities.

**Who You Are**

You are a highly analytical finance professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, financial modeling, and collaboration. You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and partnering with stakeholders across multiple geographies and functions.

**If you have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
* Experience within a Big 4 accounting firm strongly preferred.

* Progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, or Commercial Finance.
* Experience supporting global organizations and collaborating with international stakeholders.
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and business analysis skills.
* Experience performing variance analysis and translating financial results into business insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling techniques.
* Experience working with ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, and large datasets.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence business partners.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company preferred.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!

**The Benefits of Working Here**  
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

**How We Hire**

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.

**About Us**

At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com!

**Ready to Join Us?**

You will help define the right models, tools and mechanisms necessary to address business opportunities, drive automation, improve controllership and earn trust across the tax organization. Amazon has a culture of being builders and you will get to use the latest technology and internal Amazon tools to help scale big and fast.  
  
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated great attention to detail, a proven track record of building and improving complex financial models, effective written and verbal communication skills and a strong desire to continuously learn and invent. You must be a fast learner who can quickly understand Amazon's data structure. You need to be analytical in decision-making with ability to drive issues to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Perform hands-on data delivery, detailed data research and analysis of large-scale, complex financial data sets; investigate, troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data
* Collaborate with customer teams to identify opportunities for improving efficiency and controllership in current processes to eliminate manual efforts within the US Federal Tax Return and worldwide tax provision
* Drive process improvements and coordinate with the Tax Technology team to facilitate streamlining and automation
* Develop tax models for various tax calculations and review tools through the creation of end-to-end scalable processes by leveraging technology.
* Preparation and review of tax adjustments, audit-ready workpapers and federal tax returns for US reporting
* Stay up-to-date on tax law and organizational impact of those changes

  
About the team  
The Federal Reporting and Compliance team manages Amazon's worldwide taxable income calculations and federal tax obligations. We own the full lifecycle of federal tax provision and compliance, including worldwide taxable income calculations for quarterly closes, forecasts, and annual returns. While collaborating with specialist teams on areas like stock compensation, R&D credits, and TCJA provisions, we drive technological innovation and process improvements to enhance efficiency and controllership in our deliverables. Our work directly impacts Amazon's global tax provision and US federal income tax reporting.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business or related field
* 2+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
* Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
* Experience with Corptax tax return and provision preparation or equivalent software
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* CPA
* Passion for process, data and efficiencies
* Positive mindset, strong professionalism, sound judgment and an insatiable intellectual curiosity

The Quality Assurance Analyst will perform quality assurance activities for a large, web-based, cloud-hosted application used to create and support cloud-provisioned systems.

jobs.title: Business Analyst II, Account Integrity
jobs.description:
**Description**
Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent unauthorized activity among hundreds of millions of eCommerce transactions across the globe? What would you do to increase trust in an online marketplace where millions of buyers create and sign in to shop at Amazon? How would you build systems that evolve over time to proactively identify and neutralize new and emerging MO?
  
  
Amazon’s Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) team is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst to support Account Integrity’s mission is to prevent bad actors from taking over existing good Customer accounts (events referred to as ATOs), and from creating new Amazon accounts (bad actor accounts, or BAAs).
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Business Analyst in BRP, you will be responsible for analyzing terabytes of data to identify specific instances of risk, broader risk trends and points of customer friction, developing scalable solutions for prevention. In addition you will be responsible for building a robust set of operational and business metrics and will utilize metrics to determine improvement opportunities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Understand the various operations across BRP
* Understand the requirements of stakeholders and map them with the data sources/data warehouse
* Design and develop highly available dashboards and metrics using Tableau, Excel and SQL.
* Provide wing-to-wing project lifecycle execution (project planning, execution, risk assessment and system availability)
* Execute high priority (i.e. cross functional, high impact) projects to improve operations performance with the help of Operations Analytics managers
* Perform business analysis and data queries
* Execute analytical projects and understanding of analytical methods (like ANOVA, Distribution theory, regression)
* Identify new pattern of abuse and make recommendations for new controls and improved monitoring
* Develop and oversee the initiation of strategy recommendations

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* 5+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* Experience with SQL

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience partnering with executive-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues

Business Analysis, AI Use Case Development, Microsoft Power Platform, QA & Testing, Life Sciences

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong requirements management skills, hands-on QA/testing exposure, and experience in AI-driven solutions and Microsoft Power Platform. The ideal candidate will have experience working in or supporting the Life Sciences domain, translating business requirements into use cases, validating AI and automation solutions, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet business, functional, and quality expectations.

* Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Business Analysis | AI Use Case Development | Microsoft Power Platform | Life Sciences | QA & Functional Testing | AI Response Validation | Requirements Management | User Stories & Acceptance Criteria | UAT | Test Documentation | Stakeholder Management
