Posting Description:

**Job Title-** **Senior Business Analyst**

**Position type-** Full Time

**Work Location- Bangalore**

**Working style-** Hybrid

**Cab Facility-** Yes

**Shift Time –** 12:30pm – 9:30pm IST

**People Manager role:** No

**Required education and certifications are critical for the role-** Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.(Fulltime)S

**Required years of experience –** 10-14years of relevant experience

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**About the Role**
------------------

AI has made our developers fast. How quickly we deliver now depends on how well the work is defined, and this role is where that happens.

You'll own the application from start to finish, as the business's trusted partner and main point of contact. You'll also lead the team that builds what they need. Our business partners are experts in their field with full schedules, so they often share requests in brief. You'll understand the need behind each request, ask the questions that bring out the full picture, and deliver something better than they expected, quickly.

This is a hands-on, blended role: mostly business analyst, plus product manager, designer, tester and technical problem-solver. You'll do the work yourself, from discovery and design to story creation and testing, and lead the team by example. You'll work closely with US-based business and consulting teams who have not worked with an offshore development team before, so building trust quickly matters. You'll have a handover period working directly with the current product owner.

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* **You're a partner, not an order-taker.** You form your own view, bring recommendations, and use your judgment when something doesn't add up.
* **You take the burden off the business.** If they would otherwise enter data by hand, you offer to load it. If their data isn't clean, you work through it instead of sending it back. You know their work well enough to make the everyday design calls yourself, so they're only pulled in for the decisions that truly need them. You anticipate needs and deliver more than they asked for.
* **You push AI further than others do.** Here, AI isn't an add-on, it's how the work gets done. You're empowered to experiment boldly, keep raising the bar on what it can deliver, and move at a speed that wouldn't be possible without it.
* **You build what you'd want to use.** If something is confusing or clunky, you won't accept it, even if it technically meets the requirement.
* **You own quality.** You wrote the story, so you're the best person to confirm it does what the business intended.
* **You're a trusted source.** You move fast, and when you say something is handled, it is.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Lead the business relationship**

* Be the primary contact for new development, enhancements and production issues, and own issues from report to resolution.
* Lead demos, handle questions with confidence, and turn feedback into next steps.

**Shape and define the work**

* Lead discovery with busy stakeholders, read between the lines, and turn early ideas into a defined scope.
* Recommend what to build and what not to build, and break large initiatives into small, testable phases.
* Write user stories with detailed acceptance criteria (Gherkin preferred) that developers and AI coding tools can build from without guessing.
* Use AI across the whole workflow: discovery prep, stories, prototypes, and data work. Turn what works into reusable approaches for the team.

**Design and test for the user**

* Keep end users at the center of every decision.
* Use AI to build prototypes and settle the design before development starts.
* Test every delivered story against its scenarios, and work with the automation QA engineer so the automated scripts cover them.

**Work hands-on with data**

* Use SQL to analyze data, reconcile inconsistent source files, prepare safe, repeatable data loads, and check results against the source of truth.

**Lead the team**

* Set priorities, unblock developers, and make sure the team understands why it's building what it's building.
* Run backlog grooming, story acceptance, UAT coordination and release readiness.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required**

* 8+ years in business analysis on custom software, including leading a team or workstream.
* A track record of results: turning vague requests into well-scoped solutions, and going beyond the job description to make things easier for stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills. You're confident leading demos and discovery with senior stakeholders and pushing back constructively.
* Advanced, hands-on AI skills. AI has changed how you work.
* A real instinct for user-centered design, and the judgment to shape AI-built prototypes into an experience users find easy.
* Solid SQL, and comfort with relational data.

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of US retirement plans (401(k), pooled employer plans, recordkeeping) or Financial Services.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* The business sees you as their go-to partner and trusts your judgment, even when you push back.
* Developers rarely wait on requirements, and few defects reach the business.
* Business partners spend less time on manual work because of what you build.
* Within six months, you independently own the product area end to end.

**Summary**
-----------

The Senior Business Analyst will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams for Aon's Pooled Employer Plan (PEP) platform, a strategic solution supporting Ao…

By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.  
  
**Job Purpose:**  
  
The Senior Product Manager - Historian and Visualisation is responsible for the delivery, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of GSK's IP21, A1PE, Historian, reporting, and visualization platforms. The role translates manufacturing, engineering, and operational requirements into technical solutions that enable reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable manufacturing data management. Working with manufacturing sites, (Manufacturing Execution System) MES teams, Engineers, Architects, Quality/Validation, Service teams, and external partners, the Product Engineer designs, configures, integrates, tests, validates, and supports historian and visualization solutions aligned with global standards and product roadmaps. The role manages technical backlogs, supports requirements analysis, coordinates system integrations and data flows, and ensures data integrity, cybersecurity, performance, and platform reliability across the manufacturing technology landscape. Leverage AI-assisted tools to configure, test, and document IP21/A1PE solutions, ensuring all AI-generated outputs are validated for accuracy, data integrity, security, and (Good Practice) GxP compliance prior to release. Deliver reliable historian and visualization solutions that support manufacturing operations and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the design of IP21/A1PE solutions and integrations within the approved architecture, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, making and documenting design decisions, and ensuring alignment with architectural, operational, security, and compliance standards.
* Maintain IP21/A1PE engineering standards and reusable configuration patterns and provide technical guidance and lead engineers to ensure consistent, scalable, and supportable solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders to translate manufacturing, engineering and data requirements into IP21 solutions and improvements, and manage and prioritize the IP21 backlog based on business value, risk, compliance and operational needs.
* Deliver historian capabilities by collaborating with Engineers, Architects, MES teams and vendors.

Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them.

This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business.
* Maintain a rolling roadmap that balances new capability, technical debt, security and compliance obligations, and experience improvement; keep it honest about capacity.
* Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog.
* Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved.
* Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution.
* Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria.
* Manage dependencies across adjacent squads — identity, security, networking, service management — and escalate early when they threaten delivery.
* Own the release and change approach for user-visible change, including pilot rings, communications and rollback triggers.
* Be the voice of the employee in every prioritisation conversation, and hold the evidence to back it: research, telemetry, ticket analysis and direct observation.
* Run continuous discovery — user interviews, shadowing in the field and on the shop floor, surveys, usability testing — with the populations who are least like head office.
* Convert digital experience (DEX) telemetry and service desk data into prioritised, root-cause-addressing backlog items; treat every recurring ticket category as a product defect until proven otherwise.
* Own adoption: define what good adoption looks like before launch, measure it after, and act when it does not materialise.
* Own the product for the mobile estate: enrolment and provisioning experience, BYOD vs. corporate-owned models, app catalogue and distribution, and the employee-facing side of mobile security policy.
* Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate.
* Manage the mobile OS release cycle as a recurring product event: annual iOS and Android major releases, beta assessment, compatibility validation and controlled rollout.
* Own the product relationship with mobile carriers, MDM platform vendors and app suppliers.
* Build and maintain relationships across business units, regions and functions; run a stakeholder forum or product council that makes trade-offs visible rather than fought in private.
* Partner with Cyber Security to land control changes in ways employees will accept and comply with — security outcomes delivered through good product design rather than mandate.
* Engage works councils, employee representatives and Privacy where mobile telemetry, BYOD or device monitoring is in scope.
* Report on product performance to senior stakeholders in outcome terms.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
* Product ownership certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), ITIL v4 Foundation, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate).

**Area of Specialisation**

jobs.title: Senior PMT, Cart Building and Consolidation
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

What if you could shape how millions of customers across emerging markets receive their orders — and do it as part of an AI-native product organization built from the ground up? Amazon International Emerging Stores Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX) owns basket building and delivery consolidation, one of the most critical levers for reducing cost-to-serve across 12+ international markets including Mexico, Brazil, Australia, India and the Middle East. This is not about layering AI onto existing systems; you will define what AI-native product development looks like at Amazon, designing the team, the roadmap, and the operating model from scratch. As a Senior Product Manager - Technical, you will use first principles thinking and strong judgment to drive major improvements in delivery efficiency and customer convenience at a scale that few roles can offer. This role requires international travel to markets such as Mexico, Brazil, Australia and the Middle East to work directly with local teams and customers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for basket building and delivery consolidation across 12+ international markets, making clear trade-offs between customer convenience, cost-to-serve, and speed.
* Design AI-native product capabilities from the ground up, identifying where AI can reshape delivery consolidation rather than incrementally improve existing workflows.
* Partner with engineering, science, design, and country teams to translate local customer needs into scalable, cross-market solutions.
* Define success criteria and metrics that track both adoption and real-world outcomes such as cost savings and customer satisfaction, using data to inform roadmap priorities.
* Collaborate with senior leadership to align priorities across the international portfolio, influencing roadmap decisions and building agreement among stakeholders with different market contexts.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with a working session alongside engineers and scientists reviewing how an AI model performs on delivery consolidation recommendations, followed by a call with a country team to understand local cart-building patterns. After lunch you could be writing a product requirements document or building a prototype for a new consolidation feature, then joining an architecture review to talk through scalability trade-offs. You will travel to key markets- Mexico, Brazil, Australia and the Middle East, to work directly with customers and local teams, making sure the products you build reflect real-world needs across the international footprint.  
  
About the team  
We sit within Amazon International Emerging Stores Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX), where our mission is to help customers across emerging markets build smarter carts and receive their orders more conveniently and efficiently. Basket building and delivery consolidation is one of three strategic pillars for International Emerging Stores, and our charter carries high visibility and direct senior leadership sponsorship. We are building an AI-native organization from day one, and the work we do here will set the standard for how Amazon approaches AI-driven product development internationally. If you are excited about tackling large-scale, ambiguous problems that touch millions of customers and growing by shaping customer-facing delivery experiences across some of the world's fastest-growing markets, this is the team for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Senior Specialist, Business Analysis

Role Summary

**TrustWealthX (TWX) is BetaNXT’s trust platform for financial institutions and operates without a dedicated scrum team. As the Business Analyst, you will partner closely with the TWX Product Manager and manage day-to-day execution, enabling her to focus on strategy, sales, and client relationships. Your responsibilities will include defining requirements, triaging production issues, onboarding clients, and coordinating with Fi-TeK and BetaNXT’s product and engineering teams. You will report to the Head of Operations Platforms while working as an integral member of the Product Manager’s team.**

**4. Key responsibilities**

**Requirements and documentation**

* Write business requirements that earn sign-off from internal teams, clients, and Fi-TeK.
* Produce data flows, process flows, Epics, and Stories that engineering can build from without a follow-up meeting.
* Keep a decision log so scope, rationale, and approvals are traceable.

**Client onboarding**

* Run onboarding workstreams for new TWX clients, from requirements gathering through go-live readiness.
* Document each client’s configuration, data, and process needs, and track open items to closure.
* Turn what you learn from each onboarding into reusable templates for the next one.

**Production issue triage**

* Work incoming production issues through ServiceNow and JIRA, assess impact, and route them to the right team.
* Gather the evidence engineering needs, including SQL and Snowflake analysis of the underlying data.

* Trace and analyze end-to-end transaction flows from Beta Host through Snowflake to Fi-TeK, validating data completeness, accuracy, sequencing, and processing outcomes.
* Troubleshoot transaction and data-processing issues across system boundaries, isolate root causes, identify impacted records, and coordinate resolution with BetaNXT engineering and Fi-TeK.

* Keep clients and internal stakeholders informed on status, and document root cause and resolution.

**Fi-TeK and cross-team coordination**

* Act as a day-to-day working contact with Fi-TeK on requirements, dependencies, and open questions.
* Align BetaNXT product management and engineering teams on priorities and handoffs, since no dedicated team exists to do it for you.
* Cover for the PM in client, partner, and internal meetings when she is unavailable.

**Sales support**

* Help the PM prepare for prospect conversations with accurate process flows, capability summaries, and answers to technical and operational questions.
* Draft inputs for proposals and RFP responses, and join prospect calls when needed.

**Delivery visibility and analysis**

* Build and maintain JIRA dashboards that show the state of platform work, and link JIRA work items to Confluence documentation.
* Prepare release documentation for platform changes.
* Analyze platform and client data to support decisions, surface trends, and answer questions from the PM, Clients, Partner, and leadership.

* Analyze transaction volumes, processing trends, exceptions, and anomalies to identify emerging issues, explain variances, support capacity planning, and provide actionable insights to product, operations, clients, and partners.

* Use LLM and AI tools to speed up drafting, analysis, and documentation, and check their output before it goes out.

**5. Boundaries**

**The BA does not own the following:**

* Product strategy, roadmap priorities, or pricing, which belong to the PM and the Head of Operations Platforms.
* Final decisions on commercial terms, contracts, or client escalations.
* Engineering design, estimation, or code quality, which belong to the engineering teams and Fi-TeK.
* Project or resource management for other teams.
* Final sign-off on client or partner requirements, which the BA obtains but does not grant.

**6. Artifacts**

**Owned**

* Business requirements documents
* Data flow and process flow diagrams
* Epics and Stories in JIRA
* Decision log
* Client onboarding checklists and tracking
* JIRA dashboards and Confluence-to-JIRA linkage
* Production issue summaries and root cause notes
* Release documentation coordination

**Co-owned with the PM**

* Prospect-facing process and capability materials
* Client status updates and issue communications
* Platform backlog and prioritization inputs

**7. Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Business analysis experience on software development projects.
* Experience working in Agile environments.
* Ability to work independently, manage your own priorities, and own outcomes.
* Working knowledge of Confluence, JIRA, ServiceNow, Snowflake, and SQL.

* Hands-on experience using SQL and Snowflake to trace transaction flows, reconcile data across systems, troubleshoot processing issues, and perform trend, volume, and exception analysis.

* Strong written and verbal communication with clients, partners, and technical teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or trust FinTech.
* Experience coordinating with third-party vendors or partners on delivery.
* Hands-on use of LLM and AI tools in day-to-day analysis and documentation.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale.  
  
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them.  
  
About the Mansort Team  
  
The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers.  
  
We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises.  
  
Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs.  
  
Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation.  
  
As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments.  
  
Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements.  
  
Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation.  
  
Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies.  
  
Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions.  
  
Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience.  
  
Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization.  
  
Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability.  
  
Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance to strengthen team capabilities.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?
* You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

**What we're looking for:**

* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 3+ yrs with at least 1+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Listings, EM SX
jobs.description:
**Description**
Every day, millions of customers rely on Amazon to give them access to one of the world's largest selection of consumer goods. Catalog is foundational to Amazon retail, acting as the base for both the customer and fulfilment shopper CX. At same time, we need to make the catalog creation process aka Listings simpler for our sellers. Our vision is to enable SPs of any size to list their selection quickly, easily and in a self-service manner. The EM SX Listings team creates tools to enable sellers to create high quality listings on amazon with minimum friction. We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own & drive improvements to simplify seller experience in listings their products on Amazon across desktop, mobile and APIs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to facilitate the effortless creation of Amazon listings by sellers. The role entails the crucial responsibility of empowering selling partners, comprising both sellers and vendors, to efficiently and effectively list their products on the Amazon marketplace. The goal is to ensure that these product listings maintain their buyability for the maximum possible duration, all while simplifying the process and minimizing hurdles for sellers to qualify for Amazon's platform.
  
  
The individual in this role will have end-to-end ownership, which includes defining the overall strategy, collaborating with engineering and machine learning teams to develop solutions, and meticulously monitoring metrics to track progress across Amazon's extensive eCommerce pipeline. Furthermore, they must grasp the intricacies of emerging markets and strategize accordingly for sellers within the Amazon ecosystem. This necessitates close collaboration with numerous global teams, often requiring the ability to influence without direct authority. It is also imperative that the role holder stays abreast of the latest technological advancements, including Large Language Models, and present a product strategy that leverages these innovations to simplify the listing process.
  
  
This role is highly influential, with significant business impact, and provides visibility to leaders both in India and across the global platform teams. Regular updates to senior leadership are essential, and it requires a high degree of ownership, a bias for taking action, and thinking on a grand scale in an environment where contributions are distributed among multiple stakeholders. Exceptional influencing skills are crucial to drive initiatives forward. Additionally, international connectivity is key, and the individual must be willing to invest in building networks with business and tech teams on a global scale.
  
  
A successful candidate for this role should have a proven background in product management, scaling systems with extensive data sets, and a track record of delivering results in a fast-paced setting. Strong development experience, familiarity with software development cycles, and a history of managing large cross-functional projects are essential. Given the inherent ambiguity in the role, analytical thinking and superb problem-solving skills are also prerequisites, as many of the challenges are unique to Amazon's vast scale.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Manage business and technical requirements, ensuring overall coordination, quality, and acting as the primary contact for global stakeholders of your products and goals.
* Collaborate with scientists, economists, and engineers to deliver scalable ML models and generate customer insights at scale, while building project roadmaps.
* Apply scientific, engineering, and business best practices to drive innovation.
* Create high-quality documents (narratives & PR FAQs) to articulate your vision and report on initiatives to senior leadership.
* Influence feature and priority decisions with tech and platform teams based on overall impact and speed to market.
* Advocate for the needs of Emerging Market customers on a global stage.

**About The Team**
The Emerging Market Seller Experience (EM SX) team envisions Amazon as the preferred marketplace for Selling Partners in Emerging Markets. They strive to simplify the process for any Selling Partner to launch and expand a successful business on Amazon. The Listings team within this group develops tools and products that reduce friction for Amazon sellers when listing their products. Serving as the voice of sellers in Emerging Markets (including IN, MENA, APAC, LATAM), they create user-friendly, scalable solutions to address their unique needs.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Product Owner – ERM**

* The Product Owner turns business vision into customer value by acting as the voice of the customer and the primary point of contact for demand for the team. The role manages and prioritises a transparent product backlog, translates user and business needs into actionable items, and assures clear linkage through the golden thread from strategy to delivery. Working closely with business users, Product and Technology leads, Architects and the Agile Team, the Product Owner enables the realisation of agreed OKRs and delivers compliant, secure and scalable outcomes. The role also provides delivery assurance, supports product roadmap development and balances new change with operational resilience and institutional risk considerations.

**In this role, you will:**

* Define, communicate and cascade the product vision, value proposition, OKRs and roadmap across the end-to-end team so everyone remains aligned on what is to be built and why.
* Own the backlog end-to-end by managing intake and demand, expressing backlog items with acceptance criteria, prioritising demand and keeping the backlog visible, transparent and clear.
* Translate customer and business needs into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, including decisions on what not to build where value is not evidenced.
* Build, refine and maintain a rolling wave product roadmap aligned to wider Value Stream and SVS goals, the Future State Architecture and re-use of existing assets where possible.
* Work with the Agile Team to evaluate solution options through prototyping, user research and early, continuous feedback on incremental releases.
* Make trade-off decisions based on value, risk and dependencies, including balancing short-term and long-term priorities, operational resilience and change.
* Accept or reject release-ready and released solutions against the Definition of Done and agreed acceptance criteria, and sign off product releases on behalf of users where required.
* Align and actively manage stakeholders across Business and Technology, resolve conflicting priorities and maintain clear communication with users and key stakeholders.
* Provide delivery assurance by inspecting outcomes, evaluating progress, supporting Agile ceremonies, PI and QPI events, and protecting team focus on prioritised work items.
* Ensure compliance, risk management and operational resilience are addressed within product scope, while supporting Agile, SAFe, CoE and Community of Practice best practices.

**To be successful you will:**

* Strong product management capability, with strategic thinking and a clear orientation towards value creation and delivery outcomes.
* Agile and SAFe acumen, including backlog ownership, prioritisation, delivery assurance and decision-making under uncertainty.
* Ability to identify and understand customer and business needs, and translate them into actionable backlog items, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, negotiation and conflict resolution across Business and Technology.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to align stakeholders to the product vision, roadmap and OKRs.
* Awareness of compliance, institutional risk, operational resilience and quality requirements within product scope.

**Desirable (nice to have):**

* Critical thinking, analytical problem-solving and data management literacy.
* Technology services awareness and the ability to work closely with Architects in keeping with the Future State Architecture and re-use of assets where possible.
* Experience of building and maintaining rolling wave product roadmaps and supporting PI or QPI planning events.
* Leadership without line management, including a coaching mindset and the ability to help enable high-performing, self-managed teams.
* Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to participate in relevant Centres of Excellence and Communities of Practice.

**Additional Notes**

* This role owns backlog, prioritisation and value decisions within product scope, but does not carry direct line management responsibility, technical implementation decisions, budget ownership or enterprise-wide strategy setting.
* The Product Owner is expected to maintain a robust single intake management process, preserve the golden thread from strategy to delivery, meet the Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and make consistent use of the tooling spine.
* Good practice includes maintaining a transparent, well-groomed backlog, engaging stakeholders early and often, using data and feedback to inform decisions, prioritising based on value and risk, and ensuring compliance and security are built in rather than bolted on.
* Common pitfalls include acting as a mini project manager instead of a value owner, dictating technical solutions, allowing the backlog to become stale or unprioritised, overpromising or providing poor communication.

Location: Bangalore, India Company: Bridgestone Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  

* Role Overview

Bridgestone is seeking an experienced Product Owner – Data Platform to drive the strategy, development, and continuous enhancement of data products and platform capabilities that support business decision-making and operational efficiency.
  
  
The Product Owner will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear product requirements, prioritized backlogs, and measurable outcomes. The role will work closely with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Architects, and other cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, high-quality data solutions that generate business value.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product ownership and stakeholder management skills with a solid understanding of modern data platforms, data engineering, analytics, and cloud technologies. The candidate should be comfortable translating business requirements into data use cases, analytical requirements, data models, dashboards, and actionable technical stories.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Product Strategy and Roadmap
* Define and maintain the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data platform products in alignment with Bridgestone's business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, reporting capabilities, data accessibility, and operational efficiency through data-driven solutions.
* Translate business objectives into product goals, measurable outcomes, and prioritized initiatives.
* Evaluate and prioritize feature enhancements, platform capabilities, data integration requirements, and technical improvements based on business value, customer impact, risk, and effort.
* Drive continuous improvement and innovation across data products and platform capabilities.
* Business Requirement Analysis and Product Backlog Management
* Engage with business stakeholders to understand business processes, challenges, reporting needs, KPIs, and data requirements.
* Translate business requirements into epics, features, user stories, use cases, functional specifications, and clear acceptance criteria.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring requirements are refined and ready for development.
* Collaborate with Data Analysts to define business metrics, KPIs, reporting requirements, dashboard expectations, and analytical use cases.
* Work with Data Engineers to translate business requirements into data ingestion, transformation, integration, modeling, and pipeline requirements.
* Resolve requirement ambiguities, manage dependencies, and ensure alignment between business expectations and technical implementation.
* Data Platform and Product Delivery
* Partner with Data Engineering teams to deliver scalable and reliable data pipelines, data transformations, and platform capabilities.
* Understand the principles of modern data architectures, including Medallion Architecture (Raw, Silver, and Gold layers), data ingestion, transformation, and data modeling.
* Facilitate discussions on source-to-target mapping, data availability, refresh frequency, dependencies, data lineage, and downstream consumption.
* Coordinate delivery of data products built using AWS, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, SQL, and related technologies.
* Work with engineering teams on data integration requirements involving AWS services such as S3, Glue, Aurora/RDS, Lambda, and Step Functions.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, sprint reviews, release planning, and dependency management.
* Proactively identify and resolve delivery blockers, scope conflicts, and cross-team dependencies.
* Collaboration with Data Engineers and Data Analysts
* Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders, Data Engineers, and Data Analysts.
* Ensure Data Engineers have clear requirements for pipeline development, transformations, data models, validation, reconciliation, and operational workflows.
* Ensure Data Analysts have a clear understanding of business questions, KPI definitions, data requirements, dashboard specifications, and expected insights.
* Coordinate the complete flow from business requirement discovery through data ingestion, processing, validation, analytics, and business consumption.
* Facilitate collaboration between engineering and analytics teams to resolve data discrepancies, quality issues, and inconsistencies in business metrics.
* Ensure that delivered data products are fit for purpose, documented, validated, and ready for business adoption.
* Data Quality, Governance, and Reliability
* Define and prioritize data quality expectations covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and reliability.
* Partner with Data Engineers and Data Analysts to establish appropriate validation rules, reconciliation processes, quality checks, and monitoring requirements.
* Ensure data defects are prioritized based on business impact and that root causes and corrective actions are tracked to closure.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Security, and relevant governance teams on data access, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure data products meet agreed non-functional requirements, including availability, performance, scalability, and operational support.
* Drive improvements in data reliability and reduce recurring data quality issues and production incidents.
* Stakeholder Management and Communication
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and analytics teams.
* Communicate product roadmaps, priorities, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and release plans transparently.
* Facilitate requirement workshops, stakeholder discussions, backlog prioritization sessions, and product demonstrations.

The Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering medical product capabilities that meet customer and market needs. The role collaborates closely with customers, product management, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver innovative, interoperable, and compliant healthcare solutions.
  
  
Internal Stakeholders
  
  
Product Line Manager, Product Manager, Project Manager, Quality Manager, Development Team (e.g. Scrum Master, System Analyst, Architect, Developers, Testers), Usability Engineer, other stakeholders (e.g. Business Units), SCM (Enabling) & Customer Service teams, Technical Writers, etc.

**Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of healthcare IT, radiology, and clinical workflows.
* Experience with HIS, RIS, PACS, EMR/EHR, and medical reporting solutions.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards: HL7, FHIR, DICOM, and IHE.
* Familiarity with healthcare integrations and interface platforms .
* Knowledge of SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.
* Experience in requirements engineering, Agile (Scrum/SAFe), SDLC, and Product Lifecycle Management.
* Understanding of medical device regulations (FDA 21 CFR Part 820, MDR, ISO 13485).

* Knowledge of Reporting domain is an advantage.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Customer-focused with strong product ownership.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
* Self-driven, results-oriented, and proactive.
* Ability to prioritize effectively and influence cross-functional teams.
* Comfortable working in global, Agile, and cross-functional environments.

**Work Experience**
Strong understanding of healthcare IT, radiology, and clinical workflows.
  
  

* Experience with HIS, RIS, PACS, EMR/EHR, and medical reporting solutions.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards: HL7, FHIR, DICOM, and IHE.
* Familiarity with healthcare integrations and interface platforms .
* Knowledge of SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.
* Experience in requirements engineering, Agile (Scrum/SAFe), SDLC, and Product Lifecycle Management.
* Understanding of medical device regulations (FDA 21 CFR Part 820, MDR, ISO 13485).
* Previous experience in software development is preferred.
* Knowledge of Reporting domain is an advantage.

jobs.title: Fund Accounting and Administration Product Owner - Insurance Accounting, Vice President
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are seeking a
**senior business Product Owner**
for the Insurance Accounting product within State Street’s Fund Accounting and Administration platform. This role represents accounting, operational, regulatory, and client needs and serves as a senior business authority across complex functional areas and strategic initiatives.
  
  
This is
**not a technical product owner role**
. While the position partners closely with technology and development teams, accountability is focused on
**business requirements, accounting logic, client outcomes, regulatory compliance, product strategy and prioritization**
, rather than system architecture or technical solution design.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Vice President, Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that product capabilities and enhancements accurately reflect insurance and investment accounting requirements and deliver meaningful value to clients. By acting as the voice of the business, this role ensures solutions are fit for purpose, compliant, and aligned with product strategy, while enabling efficient and effective delivery through agile development teams. The role also drives alignment across business and technology stakeholders, and supports investment decisions for complex, multi-year initiatives.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As the Vice President, Product Owner, you will act as a
**senior business lead and subject matter expert**
for the Insurance Accounting product and related strategic initiatives. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Serving as one of the primary business authorities for insurance accounting functionality and related reporting
* Communicating product direction and measurable business outcomes for assigned product capabilities
* Leading complex product initiatives and enhancements that span multiple business processes, client segments, or delivery teams
* Engaging clients and internal stakeholders to understand needs, priorities, and impacts
* Leading business analysis and functional design efforts; creating clear business design documents and requirements
* Defining accounting ledger entries, multi-cost basis behavior, and accounting outcomes for enhancements
* Establishing needs for reporting solutions and ensuring alignment with accounting, regulatory, and client requirements
* Translating business and accounting requirements into well-defined epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Providing business use cases and functional testing scenarios
* Providing senior-level oversight of testing strategy and validating accounting accuracy, control effectiveness, and business outcomes
* Partnering with product management, development, operations, client service, and other stakeholders to manage dependencies, resolve issues, and maintain an actionable backlog
* Assisting with product roadmaps and longer-term functional direction, including recommendations for modernization
* Overseeing delivery of enhancements through iterative planning, prioritizing business value and client impact
* Identifying cross-product and data dependencies and driving alignment across accounting, reporting, operational, and client-facing capabilities
* Creating and maintaining user documentation
* Delivering training sessions, and product demonstrations for internal teams and current or prospective clients
* Supporting software maintenance and client service teams with business-level troubleshootingAssisting onboarding teams and clients with conversions and implementations, as needed

**What We Value**
The following skills and attributes will help you succeed in this role:
  
  

* Strategic product leadership and the ability to translate business objectives into clear product direction and priorities
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to make informed decisions in complex or ambiguous situations
* Deep analytical and research capabilities
* Sound accounting judgment and attention to financial details
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously
* Clear and effective communication with a wide range of stakeholders
* Strong presentation and written communication skills
* Ability to build alignment and drive accountability across complex initiatives
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft tools (Copilot, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field; advanced degree, CPA, CFA, or relevant product experience is preferred.
* 12+ years of experience as a business Product Owner, product leader, or senior end user of insurance, fund accounting, or financial software
* OR 12+ years of experience as a senior business analyst, business Product Owner, or product leader supporting financial or accounting platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading complex product initiatives
* Strong experience with insurance accounting and/or investment accounting, including complex asset classes (e.g., fixed income, derivatives, mortgage loans, alternative investments)
* Knowledge of inbound and outbound data flows across the investment lifecycle (e.g., trade processing, cash, market data)
* Experience leading within an agile software development environment as a business Product Owner, product leader, or senior business analyst
* Significant experience working directly with clients and other stakeholders
* Experience with AI tools and applying them to improve product development, analysis, and day-to-day business processes

*This role does not require hands-on software development, system architecture design, or technical solution ownership.*
**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them…

jobs.title: Oracle Incentive Compensation Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

As the Oracle Incentive Compensation (OIC) Product Owner, you will drive the strategic implementation, optimization, and governance of our global Incentive compensation platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT engineering teams, ensuring incentive compensation plans, crediting logic, and payout calculations align with business strategy and operate seamlessly. By applying a data-driven approach and scalable product management principles, you will enhance accuracy and deliver high-impact automated compensation solutions.The role will involve driving the successful delivery of the solution while considering the end-to-end view.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Vision & Roadmap:**
  Define and maintain the product roadmap for Oracle Incentive Compensation for new acquisitions, aligning with global sales strategy.
* **Backlog Management:**
  Author detailed user stories, define acceptance criteria, and prioritize the sprint backlog to ensure the engineering team delivers maximum business value.
* **Requirements Gathering and Analysis:**
  Collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and internal teams to gather requirements. Conduct research, stakeholder analysis, and user feedback analysis to inform product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:**
  Collaborate with Sales Operations, Finance, and HR to translate complex compensation plans and quota models into functional system requirements.
* **Process Optimization:**
  Identify opportunities to automate manual processes.
* **UAT & Quality Assurance:**
  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new releases, ensuring accurate incentive calculations.
* **Data and Process Governance:**
  Ensure seamless data flow between OIC (actuals/payouts) and upstream and downstream systems.
* **Data Driven / Prioritization:**
  Bring a data-driven approach to the product and provide insights into how the product is performing and capturing business value. Using those data insights, prioritize effectively to drive the product forward using data insights to make decisions

**Basic Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  6+ years of experience in Product Ownership or Business Analysis, specifically within the
  **Oracle Incentive compensation/Sales planning**
  suite.
* **Core Expertise:**
  Deep functional knowledge of
  **Oracle Incentive Compensation**
  (Rules engine, Plan components, Credits, and Payouts) and Sales planning process
* **Agile Mastery:**
  Proven track record working in an Agile/Scrum environment, managing ceremonies and using tools like Jira. Leading cross-functional teams and curating product backlogs.
* **Analytical Mindset:**
  Ability to troubleshoot complex logic within compensation formulas and SQL-based data sets.
* **Domain Knowledge:**
  Deep comprehension of product features, industry standards, and security protocols.
* **Solving:**
  Skill in maneuvering through ambiguous scenarios and resolving operational roadblocks independently.
* **Proactive Execution:**
  High initiative with a focus on achieving strategic objectives autonomously.
* **Analytical Aptitude:**
  Exceptional capacity for synthesizing intricate requirements into actionable functional specs.
* **Communication & Leadership:**
  Superior written and verbal skills, proficient at driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
**ServiceChannel**
is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facilities management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. ServiceChannel is well established, but even after almost 20 years we still retain the spirit of a startup. We are primed for success, and we are currently on a high growth trajectory. We are committed to crafting a great product for our customers and an extraordinary work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Owner to join us to help us expand our service offerings. Our ideal candidate has a solid track record of successful project executions for enterprise applications and will serve as a project coordinator and communicator for all relevant business areas throughout the product development lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead standard agile development ceremonies and backlog management
* Manage cross-team (dev, design, product, etc.) initiatives
* Translate high level product requirements into detailed requirements and practical work guidelines for engineering teams to follow
* Help scope projects and come up with high-level estimations
* Serve as the single point of contact for project information & status
* Proactively uncover and address issues and open items
* Create and maintain master project schedule in partnership with engineering
* Ensure all project tasks have clear owners (dev and non-dev) and that timelines from inception to rollout are understood and have clear drivers
* Adjust project schedules with Eng leads and communicate impact as plans change
* Run meetings effectively, set agenda, send detailed follow up, and drive to decisions
* Define engineering tactics:
* Work breakdown
* Teams involved
* Reprioritize maintenance backlog
* Define achievable benchmarks
* Complete Transfer of Information (TOI) sessions

**Experience, Skills & Education**

* 3+ years of experience in project management
* 2+ years of experience as a Product Owner in B2B/SaaS organization
* 2+ years of experience in Agile & Scrum processes
* Innovative thinking and problem-solving skills
* Solid knowledge of and practical experience with project management, agile software development, software engineering, designing and developing reliable and scalable web-based, high-volume data applications
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Experience working with multiple geographies using collaboration tools
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related technical field
* Experience with business applications and software development management applications such as Jira, Word, Excel and/or Project
* Experience managing people will be a plus!

**ServiceChannel**
helps many of your favorite brands manage their brick-and-mortar facilities. Our customers are market leaders in the retail, restaurant, grocery, convenience store, fitness, banking, education and health industries. The facilities and store operations teams at CVS, Trader Joe’s, Adidas, Louis Vuitton and Chipotle, among 500 other brands in over 70+ countries, rely on ServiceChannel to deliver the best possible guest and employee experience. We are the leader in our space, and we continue to earn that position by innovating within data analytics, IOT, and machine learning through our market-leading software and services.
  
  
As a brand that is shaping the future of our industry, we only succeed by recruiting and developing the best talent available. This is a team that is driven to do better, emphasizes continuous improvement, acts with integrity and works together to win together.
  
  
In 2021, we joined the
**Fortive**
group of leading technology companies, united by a common purpose to make the world stronger, safer and smarter. Fortive accelerates ServiceChannel’s growth through extraordinary business systems, cross-industry expertise and employee development resources.
  
  
Fortive is a diversified industrial growth company comprised of global businesses that are recognized leaders in attractive markets. With more than $6 billion in annual revenues, Fortive’s well-known brands hold leading positions in field instrumentation, transportation, sensing, product realization, automation and specialty, and franchise distribution. Fortive is headquartered in Everett, Washington and employs a team of more than 24,000 research and development, manufacturing, sales, distribution, service and administrative employees in more than 40 countries around the world. Our team grows by tackling challenges that accelerate progress and further their careers. With a culture rooted in continuous improvement, the core of our company’s operating model is the Fortive Business System. For more information please visit: www.fortive.com.
  
  
Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process should ask to speak with a Human Resources representative to request an accommodation.

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

jobs.title: BUK TESCO Bank IN - Colleague Product Owner - VP
jobs.description:
Join us as a “BUK TESCO Bank IN - Colleague Product Owner – VP” at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
**To be successful as a BUK TESCO Bank IN - Colleague Product Owner – VP, you should have experience with:**

* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of software engineering concepts and system architecture
* Experience with Agile tools such as Jira, AWS, DevOps, or Confluence
* Proven experience in Process Mapping, Gap Analysis, Stakeholder Management, Retail and Digital Banking, Payments and Card Processing
* Good understanding of KYC / AML Compliance, Core Banking Systems, Financial Products and Services and Risk and Regulatory Requirements
* Proven ability to read and translate Open API/Swagger Specs and UCRs to defi ne and document API requirements (user stories, acceptance criteria, data models)
* Proven ability to define and document requirements. Draft user stories, acceptance criteria, data models

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong facilitation and negotiation skills
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role will be based in our Bengaluru, India office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.
* Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
* Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.
* Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog.
* Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.
* Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.
* Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.
* Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.
* Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.
* Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadershi…
